content_zh:
“魔镜魔镜告诉我，要怎样才能阻止女王继续做坏事？”邢烨问道。
这才是最关键的要素，无论系统还是旁白甚至是镜子都没有告诉邢烨，但它隐藏在剧情中，需要执行者自己去摸索。
时至今日，邢烨已经大致摸透系统的模式了。
它给予顺命者全部规则、幸运值、站在上帝视角的优势以及限制，给予逆命者劣势、隐瞒和自由。
邢烨曾经思考过，操纵者有三个，他们达成六个结局中的一个就可以获胜，其中三个主角是克莱尔，他们无法掌控，可另外三个却是他们自身，其实只要设计一个侍卫长因爱生恨暗杀女王男宠的结局，就无需克莱尔直接获胜。
如果是邢烨，一定会这么做，但他们并没有。是想不到吗？不应该，三个臭皮匠赛过诸葛亮，一个人想不到正常，三个人一同商议还想不到的话，那活着还有什么价值，重新投胎算了。
他们应该不是想不到，而是做不到。
邢烨推测他们的结局应该是选择模式的，只能从系统规定的几个结局中选择，不允许出现自杀或者互相残杀的结局。
不像是邢烨，系统没有给他任何信息，也就是没有给他任何限制，他可以自由行动。
但这不代表邢烨可以为所欲为，因为他有三个对手。
正如一开始他不愿意拿起镜子，对手强行改变旁白逼着他获得道具镜子般，这三个操纵者不干掉，邢烨永远不可能按照自己的心意行动，他们会不惜一切代价阻挠自己。
所以第一个新手世界想要获胜的必要条件是一定要先除掉三名操纵者，在交锋过程中分析出他们为克莱尔设定的三个结局，干掉三人后，再设计出第四个结局。
只有同时做到以上几点才能够获胜。
但在过程中，系统并不是一点优势也没给邢烨。世界上最美女性的身份、任务道具镜子，这些对于普通玩家而言完全是负累的东西，其实就是系统给予逆命者的优势，但它不会直接告诉玩家，而是需要逆命者自己发现。
失去灵魂的镜子在系统操纵下回答了邢烨的问题：“我的女孩，你终于想到了这个问题。女王现在的力量是用少女们的性命换来的，她在毁容后与魔鬼做了交易，已经堕入黑暗之中。想要战胜魔鬼的力量，就需要世界上最纯洁的鲜血，也就是克莱尔你的鲜血。
如果女王还有良知，那么只要将你的一点点鲜血涂抹在镜子上，再让镜子照应出她的容貌，女王善良的心就会战胜魔鬼，当然，她的生命是靠魔鬼的力量延续的，战胜之后，她也会死去。
假若她连最后一丝良知都没有了，那么我的女孩，能够净化她的唯有你的全部鲜血与灵魂。你比女王纯洁，比她更能吸引魔鬼，它会被你不断流出的鲜血吸引，背弃女王进入你的身体中。你需要保持住自我的灵魂，就可以战胜魔鬼。”
邢烨：“……”
就是说，要么女王有良知，自我毁灭。要么克莱尔牺牲自己，把魔鬼引入体内，然后自杀，魔鬼就被消灭了，同样失去魔鬼力量的女王也会衰老而死。
加上克莱尔什么也没做就被女王杀死的结局，目前看来有三种：一，克莱尔死；二，女王死；三，两个一起死。

三选二吗？邢烨摸了摸下巴。
明明三名顺命者完全可以将三个结局全选了，偏偏有一个顺命者被安排到卢卡伯爵手下。也就是说，三选二是系统刻意为他营造的局面，它为逆命者准备唯一一条生路，是否获胜全看逆命者能不能选对。
恢复神智的镜子没心情与邢烨贫，而是紧张地问道：怎么办？
这一路与邢烨相处下来，镜子早就认定自己是邢烨阵营的人，真心希望他能够获胜。
而且在这样的绝境之下依旧可以获胜，是一件十分振奋人心的事情。
如果邢烨可以获胜，他或许也能……
“别吵。”邢烨点了下镜面，拿出纸笔写写画画。
他画了一张镜子完全看不懂的结构图，皱眉对着图想了好久，最后用笔尖点了点图纸中心，冷笑道：“陷阱，全部是陷阱。”
镜子：？
“侍卫长的举动让我确定‘克莱尔被女王杀死’是第一种结局，最终结局就从三选二变成了二选一，但其实余下两种结局归根究底可以算作一种，即‘克莱尔除掉魔鬼’，如果我从这其中二选一，不管选哪个都会输。

content_en:
"Mirror Mirror, tell me, how can I stop the Queen from doing bad things?" Xing Ye asked.
This is the most critical element. Neither the system nor the narration nor even the mirror told Xing Ye, but it is hidden in the plot and needs to be explored by the executor himself.
Today, Xing Ye has roughly figured out the system's mode.
It gives those who obey the destiny all the rules, luck, advantages and limitations from God's perspective, and gives those who disobey the destiny disadvantages, concealment and freedom.
Xing Ye once thought that there are three manipulators, and they can win if they achieve one of the six endings. Three of the protagonists are Claire, which they cannot control, but the other three are themselves. In fact, as long as the ending of the captain of the guard assassinating the queen's male favorite out of love and hatred is designed, Claire does not need to win directly.
If it were Xing Ye, he would definitely do this, but they didn't. Is it unexpected? No, three cobblers are better than Zhuge Liang. If one person can't think of normality, and if three people can't think of it after discussing together, then what's the value of living? Just reincarnate.
It’s not that they can’t think of it, but that they can’t do it.
Xing Ye speculated that their endings should be in a choice mode. They could only choose from several endings specified by the system, and suicide or mutual killing endings were not allowed.
Unlike Xing Ye, the system did not give him any information, that is, it did not give him any restrictions and he could move freely.
But this does not mean that Xing Ye can do whatever he wants, because he has three opponents.
Just as he was unwilling to pick up the mirror at the beginning, and his opponent forcibly changed the narration to force him to obtain the prop mirror. Unless these three manipulators are eliminated, Xing Ye will never be able to act according to his own wishes, and they will stop him at all costs.
Therefore, the necessary condition for winning in the first novice world is to get rid of the three manipulators first, analyze the three endings they set for Claire during the confrontation, and then design the fourth ending after killing the three.
Only by doing the above points at the same time can you win.
But in the process, the system did not give Xing Ye any advantages. The identity of the most beautiful woman in the world and the mission prop mirror, which are completely burdensome to ordinary players, are actually the advantages that the system gives to those who rebel against fate. However, it will not tell the players directly, but requires the rebels to discover it themselves.
The soulless mirror answered Xing Ye's question under the control of the system: "My girl, you finally thought about this problem. The queen's current power was exchanged for the lives of the girls. After she was disfigured, she made a deal with the devil and has fallen into darkness. If you want to defeat the devil's power, you need the purest blood in the world, which is your blood, Claire.
If the queen still has a conscience, then just smear a little of your blood on the mirror and let the mirror reflect her appearance. The queen's kind heart will defeat the devil. Of course, her life will be extended by the power of the devil. After the victory, she will also die.
If she doesn't even have the last trace of conscience, then my girl, the only thing that can purify her is all your blood and soul. You are purer than the queen and more able to attract the devil than she is. It will be attracted by the blood you continue to shed and turn its back on the queen and enter your body. You need to keep your own soul to defeat the devil. "
Xing Ye: "..."
That is, either the queen has a conscience and destroys herself. Either Claire sacrifices herself, introduces the devil into her body, and then commits suicide, the devil will be eliminated, and the queen who also loses the devil's power will age and die.
In addition to the ending where Claire is killed by the Queen without doing anything, there are currently three options: one, Claire dies; two, the Queen dies; three, both die together.
Two out of three? Xing Ye touched his chin.
Obviously the three obedient people could have chosen all three endings, but one of the obedient people was placed under Count Luca.. In other words, choosing two out of three is a situation deliberately created for him by the system. It prepares the only way out for those who defy fate. Whether he wins or not depends entirely on whether the defiant person can choose the right one.
Jing Jing, who had regained his consciousness, was not in the mood to talk to Xing Ye, but asked nervously: What should I do?
After getting along with Xing Ye all the way, Jing Jing has long since decided that he is from Xing Ye's camp and sincerely hopes that he can win.
And it is very exciting to still win in such a desperate situation.
If Xing Ye can win, maybe he can too...
"Don't make any noise." Xing Ye clicked on the mirror and took out a pen and paper to write and draw.
He drew a structural diagram that the mirror could not understand at all. He frowned and thought about the diagram for a long time. Finally, he touched the center of the drawing with the tip of his pen and sneered: "Traps, they are all traps."
Mirror:?
"The actions of the captain of the guard convinced me that 'Claire was killed by the Queen' was the first ending, and the final outcome changed from two out of three to one out of two. But in fact, the remaining two endings can be counted as one, namely 'Claire gets rid of the devil.' If I choose one of the two, no matter which one I choose, I will lose.
